arxiv-2101-08712.title: A variational discrete element method for the computation of Cosserat elasticity
arxiv-2101-08712.creator: Frédéric Marazzato Department of Mathematics, Louisiana State University, Baton Rouge, LA 70803, USA email: marazzato@lsu.edu
arxiv-2101-08712.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Frédéric Marazzato Department of Mathematics, Louisiana State University, Baton Rouge, LA 70803, USA email: marazzato@lsu.edu. The variational discrete element method developed in [ 28 ] for dynamic elasto-plastic computations is adapted to compute the deformation of elastic Cosserat materials. In addition to cellwise displacement degrees of freedom (dofs), cellwise rotational dofs are added. A reconstruction is devised to obtain P 1 P^{1} non-conforming polynomials in each cell and thus constant strains and stresses in each cell.

arxiv-2207-06548.title: A Simple Adaptive Procedure Converging to Forgiving Correlated Equilibria
arxiv-2207-06548.creator: Hugh Zhang
arxiv-2207-06548.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Hugh Zhang. Simple adaptive procedures that converge to correlated equilibria are known to exist for normal form games ( Hart & Mas-Colell 2000 ) , but no such analogue exists for extensive-form games. Leveraging inspiration from Zinkevich et al. 2008 ( \citedate zinkevich2008regret), we show that any internal regret minimization procedure designed for normal-form games can be efficiently extended to finite extensive-form games of perfect recall.

arxiv-2305-16313.title: Hybrid symmetry class topological insulators
arxiv-2305-16313.creator: Sanjib Kumar Das, Bitan Roy
arxiv-2305-16313.description: Abstract Traditional topological materials belong to different Altland-Zirnbauer symmetry classes (AZSCs) depending on their non-spatial symmetries. Here we introduce the notion of hybrid symmetry class topological insulators (HSCTIs): A fusion of two different AZSC topological insulators (TIs) such that they occupy orthogonal Cartesian hyperplanes and their universal massive Dirac Hamiltonian mutually anticommute.

arxiv-2305-18768.title: Infinite-dimensional moment-SOS hierarchy for nonlinear partial differential equations
arxiv-2305-18768.creator: Didier Henrion, Maria Infusino, Salma Kuhlmann, Victor Vinnikov
arxiv-2305-18768.description: Abstract We formulate a class of nonlinear evolution partial differential equations (PDEs) as linear optimization problems on moments of positive measures supported on infinite-dimensional vector spaces. Using sums of squares (SOS) representations of polynomials in these spaces, we can prove convergence of a hierarchy of finite-dimensional semidefinite relaxations solving approximately these infinite-dimensional optimization problems.

arxiv-2311-10626.title: Exploring the Potential for Detecting Rotational Instabilities in Binary Neutron Star Merger Remnants with Gravitational Wave Detectors
arxiv-2311-10626.creator: Argyro Sasli 1 , Nikolaos Karnesis 1 and Nikolaos Stergioulas 1 1 Department of Physics, Aristotle University of Thessaloniki, Thessaloniki 54124, Greece
arxiv-2311-10626.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Argyro Sasli 1 , Nikolaos Karnesis 1 and Nikolaos Stergioulas 1 1 Department of Physics, Aristotle University of Thessaloniki, Thessaloniki 54124, Greece. We explore the potential for detecting rotational instabilities in the post-merger phase of binary neutron star mergers using different network configurations of upgraded and next-generation gravitational wave detectors.

arxiv-2311-13177.title: Volumetric Reconstruction Resolves Off-Resonance Artifacts in Static and Dynamic PROPELLER MRI
arxiv-2311-13177.creator: Annesha Ghosh, Gordon Wetzstein, Mert Pilanci, Sara Fridovich-Keil
arxiv-2311-13177.description: Abstract Off-resonance artifacts in magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) are visual distortions that occur when the actual resonant frequencies of spins within the imaging volume differ from the expected frequencies used to encode spatial information. These discrepancies can be caused by a variety of factors, including magnetic field inhomogeneities, chemical shifts, or susceptibility differences within the tissues.

arxiv-2410-09837.title: Tomographic Model Based Iterative Reconstruction of Symmetric Objects
arxiv-2410-09837.creator: Kyle M. Champley, Ibrahim Oksuz, Matthew G. Bisbee
arxiv-2410-09837.description: Abstract Computed Tomography (CT) reconstruction of objects with cylindrical symmetry can be performed with a single projection. When the measured rays are parallel, and the axis of symmetry is perpendicular to the optical axis, the data can be modeled with the so-called Abel Transform. The Abel Transform has been extensively studied and many methods exist for accurate reconstruction.

arxiv-2410-16367.title: Scalar emission from neutron star-black hole binaries in scalar-tensor theories with kinetic screening
arxiv-2410-16367.creator: Ramiro Cayuso, Adrien Kuntz, Miguel Bezares, Enrico Barausse
arxiv-2410-16367.description: Abstract We explore scalar radiation from neutron star-black hole binaries in scalar-tensor theories with kinetic screening ( K K -essence). Using 3+1 numerical relativity simulations in the decoupling limit, we investigate scalar dipole and quadrupole radiation for different values of the strong coupling constant Λ \Lambda .

arxiv-2504-17209.title: Characterisation of Hamamatsu R11065-20 PMTs for use in the SABRE South NaI(Tl) Crystal Detectors
arxiv-2504-17209.creator: Y.Y. Zhong
arxiv-2504-17209.description: Abstract The SABRE Experiment is a direct detection dark matter experiment using a target composed of multiple NaI(Tl) crystals. The experiment aims to be an independent check of the DAMA/LIBRA results with a detector in the Northern (Laboratori Nazionali Del Gran Sasso, LNGS) and Southern (Stawell Underground Physics Laboratory, SUPL) hemispheres.

arxiv-2507-10409.title: Energy Efficiency in AI for 5G and Beyond: A DeepRx Case Study
arxiv-2507-10409.creator: Amine Lbath, Ibtissam Labriji
arxiv-2507-10409.description: Abstract This study addresses the challenge of balancing energy efficiency with performance in AI/ML models, focusing on DeepRX, a deep learning receiver based on a fully convolutional ResNet architecture. We evaluate the energy consumption of DeepRX, considering factors including FLOPs/Watt and FLOPs/clock, and find consistency between estimated and actual energy usage, influenced by memory access patterns.

arxiv-2508-12512.title: LangVision-LoRA-NAS: Neural Architecture Search for Variable LoRA Rank in Vision–Language Models
arxiv-2508-12512.creator: Krishna Teja Chitty-Venkata, Murali Emani, Venkatram Vishwanath
arxiv-2508-12512.description: Abstract Vision Language Models (VLMs) integrate visual and text modalities to enable multimodal understanding and generation. These models typically combine a Vision Transformer (ViT) as an image encoder and a Large Language Model (LLM) for text generation. LoRA (Low-Rank Adaptation) is an efficient fine-tuning method to adapt pre-trained models to new tasks by introducing low-rank updates to their weights.

pmc-10679501.title: Intention to adopt improved indigenous chicken breeds among smallholder farmers in Machakos county, Kenya. Do socio-psychological factors matter?
pmc-10679501.creator: Christopher N. Kamau, Eucabeth B. Majiwa, Geoffrey O. Otieno, Lucy W. Kabuage
pmc-10679501.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Consumption of poultry meat, eggs, and other animal-sourced commodities has dramatically risen by almost 86 %, with the demand of indigenous chicken products almost doubling over the past few decades. In Kenya, poultry farmers prefer indigenous chicken (IC) due to their resilience to harsh climatic conditions, high feed conversion rates, delicious end products, ability to scavenge and potential to reduce greenhouse gas emissions among other factors.

pmc-11446391.title: Bio-conversion of organic wastes towards polyhydroxyalkanoates
pmc-11446391.creator: Zhe-Yi Kuang, Hao Yang, Shi-Wei Shen, Yi-Na Lin, Shu-Wen Sun, Markus Neureiter, Hai-Tao Yue, Jian-Wen Ye
pmc-11446391.description: The bio-manufacturing of products with substantial commercial value, particularly polyhydroxyalkanoates (PHA), using cost-effective carbon sources through microorganisms, has garnered heightened attention from both the scientific community and industry over the past few decades. Opting for industrial PHA production from various organic wastes, spanning industrial, agricultural, municipal, and food-based sources, emerges as a wiser choice.

pmc-12652786.title: Shame or What Makes Irrational Social Anxiety Rational
pmc-12652786.creator: Artemiy Leonov, Justin P. Laplante
pmc-12652786.description: Social anxiety disorder (SAD) is defined as a pathological fear of social interactions in which an individual may be negatively evaluated by others. The crucial component of assessing the state as clinical is the ‘context-insensitivity’ of the fear—i.e., the negative evaluation does not have any tangible repercussions, or the evaluation is not as detrimentally negative, as the patient presumes.

pmc-12735702.title: Dietary Patterns Influence Chronic Disease Risk and Health Outcomes in Older Adults: A Narrative Review
pmc-12735702.creator: Jordan A. Gunning, Madeline F. Converse, Behzad Gudarzi, Wanees Lotfallah, Susan B. Racette
pmc-12735702.description: The global population is aging rapidly and the prevalence of age-related noncommunicable diseases is increasing. Favorable dietary patterns have the power to reduce the risk or progression of various age-related chronic diseases, including obesity, hypertension, cardiovascular disease, type 2 diabetes, several types of cancer, and some neurodegenerative diseases.

pmc-13206179.title: Solvent‐Induced Covalent Bond Softening Boosts Battery Voltage
pmc-13206179.creator: Yanyan Wang, Zhijie Wang, Mengzi Geng, Chunzhen Yang, Guangchao Li, Jean‐Marie Tarascon, Biao Zhang
pmc-13206179.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Increasing cell voltage is a key strategy for enhancing the energy density of lithium batteries. Previously, this was mainly achieved by adjusting the redox potentials of transition‐metal‐based cathode materials through inductive effects that altered the covalency of metal—oxygen bonds. Here, we present a novel strategy for increasing battery voltage that consists of acting on the redox potential of the electrochemically active electrode through charge transfer with the electrolyte.
